# Neuromorphic_Sensing

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A sensor architecture that mimics biological neural processing to directly extract salient features from raw signals, reducing data volume and latency at the edge. Enables in-network neuromorphic preprocessing for TCC, allowing topology-aware, low-power signal analysis before data enters the network core.
